<function name="SetAutoSize" parent="DPanelList" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets the <page>DPanelList</page> to size its height to its contents. This is set to false by default.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<file line="4">lua/vgui/dpanellist.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="shouldSizeToContents" type="boolean">Whether to size to the height of the <page>DPanelList</page> contents.</arg>
	</args>
</function>


<example>
<description>Creates a list with buttons, auto sizes the list to the buttons</description>
	<code>
local panelList = vgui.Create("DPanelList", self)
panelList:SetAutoSize(true)

for i = 1, 5 do
	local button = vgui.Create("DButton", self)
	button:SetText("Button " .. i)
	panelList:AddItem(button)
end

-- Ensure PerformLayout is called (which sets the list height to the content height)
panelList:InvalidateLayout()
	</code>

</output>
</example>
